question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Labour
solution:
The correct answer is: **Toil**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Labour"** means physical or mental work, especially of a hard or fatiguing kind. (श्रम)

 
 
• **Example:** The construction workers put in long hours of labour to complete the building.
 
 
 
• **"Toil"** refers to hard and continuous work; exhausting effort. (कड़ी मेहनत)
 
 
• **Example:** Farmers toil in the fields from dawn to dusk during the harvest season.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Toil**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mesh** (जाल): A network of wire or thread.

 
 
• **Example:** The fish got caught in the mesh of the net.
 
 
 
• **Dalliance** (विलासिता): A casual romantic or sexual relationship.
 
 
• **Example:** Their dalliance was short-lived but memorable.
 
 
 
• **Relaxation** (आराम): The state of being free from tension and anxiety.
 
 
• **Example:** Yoga is a great way to achieve relaxation after a stressful day.
